keyPoints.en: Röntgen discovered X-rays (1895); Becquerel discovered radioactivity in uranium (1896).
keyPoints.bm: Röntgen menemui sinar-X (1895); Becquerel menemui keradioaktifan dalam uranium (1896).

keyPoints.en: Marie and Pierre Curie discovered polonium and radium (1898).
keyPoints.bm: Marie dan Pierre Curie menemui polonium dan radium (1898).

keyPoints.en: Unit: becquerel (Bq). Half-life: time for half of the nuclei to decay.
keyPoints.bm: Unit: becquerel (Bq). Separuh hayat: masa untuk separuh nukleus mereput.

keyPoints.en: Nucleus: protons (+1) and neutrons (0); electrons (−1) move around it.
keyPoints.bm: Nukleus: proton (+1) dan neutron (0); elektron (−1) bergerak mengelilinginya.

keyPoints.en: Nucleon number = protons + neutrons. Isotopes: same protons, different neutrons.
keyPoints.bm: Nombor nukleon = proton + neutron. Isotop: proton sama, neutron berbeza.

keyPoints.en: Unstable nuclei decay, emitting alpha, beta or gamma radiation.
keyPoints.bm: Nukleus yang tidak stabil mereput, memancarkan sinaran alfa, beta atau gama.

keyPoints.en: Alpha (+2, stopped by paper, most ionising), beta (−1, stopped by aluminium), gamma (no charge, most penetrating).
keyPoints.bm: Alfa (+2, dihalang kertas, paling mengion), beta (−1, dihalang aluminium), gama (tiada cas, paling menembusi).

keyPoints.en: Ionising: α, β, γ, X-rays. Non-ionising: radio, microwave, infrared, visible light.
keyPoints.bm: Mengion: α, β, γ, sinar-X. Tidak mengion: radio, gelombang mikro, inframerah, cahaya nampak.

keyPoints.en: Background radiation comes from radon, cosmic rays, rocks, food and medical uses.
keyPoints.bm: Sinaran latar belakang datang dari radon, sinar kosmik, batuan, makanan dan kegunaan perubatan.

keyPoints.en: Medicine: Co-60 radiotherapy, I-131 thyroid; sterilising equipment.
keyPoints.bm: Perubatan: radioterapi Co-60, I-131 tiroid; mensteril peralatan.

keyPoints.en: Industry: thickness control (beta), leak detection (Na-24). Archaeology: C-14 dating. Agriculture: tracers, pest control.
keyPoints.bm: Industri: kawalan ketebalan (beta), pengesanan kebocoran (Na-24). Arkeologi: pentarikhan C-14. Pertanian: penyurih, kawalan perosak.

keyPoints.en: Safety: shielding (lead), distance (tongs), short exposure, film badges.
keyPoints.bm: Keselamatan: perisai (plumbum), jarak (penyepit), pendedahan singkat, lencana filem.
